description: This file defines data structures and functions for parsing error messages related to invoke errors in an Android application. It includes a data class ParsedInvokeError with associated message parsing functions.

classes.name: ParsedInvokeError
classes.description: A data class representing a parsed invoke error, including code, message, and a flag indicating if an explicit code was provided.

methods.name: parseInvokeErrorMessage
methods.description: Parses a raw error message string into a ParsedInvokeError object, extracting error code and message.

methods.name: parseInvokeErrorFromThrowable
methods.description: Creates a ParsedInvokeError from a Throwable object, using its message or a fallback message.
